anthropic-claude-haiku-5-5.description: Claude Haiku 5.5 through the Claude API OpenAI-compatible endpoint (operator's personal account)
anthropic-claude-haiku-5-5.judge_note: Claude 4.7 and later models return HTTP 400 for temperature below 1, for top_p other than 0.99, and for a request that sets both (Claude OpenAI SDK compatibility docs, read 2026-10-10). The official judge settings temperature 0 and top_p 1 are therefore removed from each request, and the model uses its default sampling. The endpoint ignores seed, presence_penalty and frequency_penalty.
anthropic-claude-haiku-5-5.judge_strip_code_fence_note: Haiku 5.5 puts its JSON replies in a ```json code fence. The official calculate_factuality() parses with plain json.loads and gives factuality 0 on failure, so without this every answer gets factuality 0 (diagnosis 2026-10-10: 0/4 replies parsed, 4/4 after fence removal; audit/diagnostics/judge_format_anthropic-claude-haiku-5-5.json). A second check (Medical-f79d978d, 3 repeats) found a fenced JSON block with a comment after the fence. If a reply is not JSON, the JSON in its first code fence is used instead (only if it is valid JSON), in memory, before the official parser reads it; prose_dropped counts the replies with text outside the fence.
anthropic-claude-haiku-5-5.price_note: Claude API list price for prompts up to 100,000 tokens (over 100,000 tokens: 0.50 / 2.50); judge prompts are far below this. Output tokens include thinking tokens.

anthropic-claude-haiku-5-5-nothink.description: Claude Haiku 5.5 with thinking disabled, through the Claude API OpenAI-compatible endpoint (operator's personal account)
anthropic-claude-haiku-5-5-nothink.judge_note: As anthropic-claude-haiku-5-5 (temperature and top_p removed; seed and penalties ignored by the endpoint).
anthropic-claude-haiku-5-5-nothink.judge_extra_body_note: Haiku 5.5 uses adaptive thinking by default; the thinking tokens are billed as output and count against the output-tokens-per-minute limit (80,000 on the operator's account), which made a full rescore take more than 10 hours. Diagnosis 2026-10-10 on 4 answers (audit/diagnostics/judge_format_anthropic-claude-haiku-5-5_think-*.json): output tokens 10,812 with default thinking, 4,487 with thinking disabled, 4,798 with thinking disabled and effort low, so effort is not changed. The OpenAI SDK sends these fields through extra_body.
